Description: The base Axis & Allies 1940 game in four variants: Global, Halifax, Europe and Pacific. This is the game without the optional default Research & Development as part of the standard ruleset.
The expansion for BASE on R&D with the technology tree including development paths in different domains: Land, Naval, Air, Manufacturing, Energy and Intelligence.
Module which includes an alternate reality scenario to integrate Axis & Allies & Zombies into Axis & Allies 1940 Global.
Module for finding and refining oil to allow your logistics to function.
Module for developing the nuclear bomb and a means to drop it.
Module which includes an alternate history scenario module to include the myths about Germany's occult research.
